searchText: Should we move this channel to the graveyard now that 1559 is live? We can use <#692078615269212180> going forward? I would also rename it to #1559-general or something. I have sometimes gotten the idea that people used this channel instead of fee-market because they didn't know what "fee-market" was (maybe some channel where you could sell/buy fees?) Oh, interesting! I was thinking about renaming <#692078615269212180> to just #fee-market now that 1559 is live, but maybe that's a bad idea 😅
